name: onix
description: Internal B2B CRM for Melas Energiaki — local development entrypoint
//: This file exists purely as a convenience launcher for running both apps
locally without Docker. It deliberately does NOT declare npm workspaces:
workspaces hoist node_modules to the root and produce a single root
lockfile, which would break the per-app lockfiles that `npm ci` relies on
inside each Dockerfile. Each app stays a fully independent package; these

scripts.setup: npm run init:env && npm run install:all && npm run db:setup && npm run migrate:up
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix apps/api run format && npm --prefix apps/web run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix apps/api run format:check && npm --prefix apps/web run format:check
